connector.name: Scamcheck MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Scan suspicious messages, URLs, and text for scams with AI. Free tier - no API key required.
connector.summary: Hosted at scamcheck.tech over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package scamcheck-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the smijo-geek account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Optional API key for higher limits (free anonymous tier works without it)
